summary: Frontend E2E verified for the new admin flow. /mis-solicitudes lists 13 reports SOL-###### from backend with correct status badges; row click routes to /requests/{id} and renders request-detail-page. Admin panel visible (auto-login is admin, header shows 'Administrador'). Status change EN PROCESO -> EN REVISIÓN via status-update-select + status-comment-input + update-status-button succeeded; toast 'Estado actualizado', badge updated, comment persisted, and public /seguimiento/{token} page (no login) shows the new status + comment in the timeline. critical_code_review_comments: MisSolicitudes.js: on error/timeout of /api/requests the catch silently sets reportes=[] with no toast/log, so users see an empty state even if session or API fails; consider surfacing an error state.
RequestDetail.js: no explicit error handling for /api/requests/{id} 404/403; if load() rejects, the page stays on the loader spinner indefinitely.
